product_one_liner.value: Talowiz provides AI recruiting agents that source, screen, assess and interview candidates and automate hiring coordination for recruiters and talent-acquisition teams.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page explains credit-based, pay-as-you-go pricing and included features, without publishing dollar amounts.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported employee count of 15.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn explicitly identifies Ashburn as headquarters; the company website displays a San Jose mailing address.

eng_blog.notes: The resource library contains recruiting advice and customer-facing product explainers, not two qualifying engineering implementation posts.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help-center link was found; the public site offers marketing pages and product FAQs rather than a multi-article documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page states: "There are no openings from Talowiz right now."

model_provider.notes: Privacy Policy section 7.3 identifies a custom AI model for persona-based personalization; it does not name an external model provider or model family.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is a publicly stated compliance framework here, not an audited certification: the privacy policy describes GDPR rights and processor obligations.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook records a completed Early Stage VC deal and names FortyTwo.VC, whose portfolio includes Talowiz; the public pages do not disclose the round date or USD amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The round date could not be verified, so funding within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09 cannot be determined.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page states there are no openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest explicit launch announcement located is the AI pipeline builder launch on 2026-02-10, before the 2026-05-09–2026-11-09 window; the resource library’s newest article is dated 2026-03-06.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated change announcement was found. The available people and directory pages did not establish a complete leadership roster with start dates, so a negative answer cannot be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy names Mailchimp for newsletters and transactional emails, Google Analytics, and Intercom for customer service; a Breakout customer testimonial quotes Talowiz’s CEO about converting visitors into pipeline. These are marketing/customer-engagement signals, not evidence of a named core CRM.
